title: Fin Box Rib Foot Bonding Resistance — Check
abstract: Four-wire bonding resistance measurement at every fin box rib foot, used to confirm the lightning current path against the published limit for each rib position.

sections.purpose: This task gives the four-wire bonding resistance measurement at the fin box rib feet, the acceptance limit for each rib position and the recording that the lightning protection substantiation depends on.
sections.job_setup_note: Work inside the fin box needs lighting, ventilation and a second person outside the access panel at all times. Confirm the calibration of the four-wire meter before the first reading. Measure with the aircraft unpowered and unbonded to a ground cart, because a ground connection changes the reading at the lower rib positions. One limit table applies, and it is derived from the path length from each rib foot to the spar.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DO NOT WORK ALONE INSIDE THE FIN BOX. KEEP A SECOND PERSON AT THE ACCESS PANEL FOR THE WHOLE TIME ANYBODY IS INSIDE. Remove power from the aircraft and disconnect any ground cart bonding lead. Open the fin box access panels and put lighting and ventilation into the box. Confirm the calibration of the four-wire meter and record it. Clean the measurement points at each rib foot with the non-metallic pad. CAUTION: DO NOT ABRADE THROUGH THE SURFACE PROTECTION AT A MEASUREMENT POINT. CLEAN ONLY TO BRIGHT METAL AT THE DESIGNATED CONTACT AREA, WHICH IS MARKED ON THE STRUCTURE. Measure the resistance from each rib foot to the spar and record it against the rib identity. Compare each reading against the limit in the illustration. Where a reading is above the limit, clean the joint again and repeat once; if it is still above the limit, report it. Apply the corrosion preventive compound to the measurement points. Inspect the shear tie D5530110749890 and the gusset kit SAD726961-22 at the lower positions for evidence of arcing.
sections.close_out: Close the fin box access panels and restore the surface protection at every point that was cleaned. Record all readings against the rib identity and the aircraft flight hours, because the trend is what the substantiation uses. Report any reading above the limit to the operator engineering department before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. One measurement per rib foot, against the limit table of the illustration.

safety_precautions: Do not work alone inside the fin box.
Remove power and disconnect any ground cart bonding lead before measuring.
Do not abrade through the surface protection at a measurement point.

title: Fin Box Rib Foot Bonding Resistance — Check

issue.reason: Acceptance limits restated per embodiment condition and the strap path added as a separate measurement instead of being read through the rib foot value.

abstract: Four-wire bonding resistance measurement at every fin box rib foot, used to confirm the lightning current path before and after strap installation and as a repeat check on aircraft that have not been modified.

sections.purpose: This task gives the four-wire bonding resistance measurement at the fin box rib feet, the acceptance limit and the recording that the lightning protection substantiation depends on.
sections.job_setup_note: Work inside the fin box needs lighting, ventilation and a second person outside the access panel at all times. Confirm the calibration of the four-wire meter before the first reading. Measure with the aircraft unpowered and unbonded to a ground cart, because a ground connection changes the reading at the lower rib positions. Establish the strap standard of the aircraft before you read a limit: the strap shortens the path at every rib foot and the published limits move with it, and three of the five feet on a strapped aircraft read outside the unmodified limit while being entirely serviceable.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DO NOT WORK ALONE INSIDE THE FIN BOX. KEEP A SECOND PERSON AT THE ACCESS PANEL FOR THE WHOLE TIME ANYBODY IS INSIDE. Remove power from the aircraft and disconnect any ground cart bonding lead. Open the fin box access panels and put lighting and ventilation into the box. Confirm the calibration of the four-wire meter and record it. Establish the strap standard and select the limit table for it. Clean the measurement points at each rib foot with the non-metallic pad. CAUTION: DO NOT ABRADE THROUGH THE SURFACE PROTECTION AT A MEASUREMENT POINT. CLEAN ONLY TO BRIGHT METAL AT THE DESIGNATED CONTACT AREA, WHICH IS MARKED ON THE STRUCTURE. Measure the resistance from each rib foot to the spar and record it against the rib identity. On aircraft with the bonding strap installation, measure the strap path separately from the fastener path and record the two values against the rib identity; do not report a single combined figure, because a failed strap and a degraded fastener path give the same combined reading and need different work. Compare each reading against the limit for the standard fitted. Where a reading is above the limit, clean the joint again and repeat once; if it is still above the limit, report it. Apply the corrosion preventive compound to the measurement points. Inspect the shear tie D5530110749890 and the gusset kit SAD726961-22 at the lower positions for evidence of arcing.
sections.close_out: Close the fin box access panels and restore the surface protection at every point that was cleaned. Record all readings against the rib identity and the aircraft flight hours, with the strap path and the fastener path separately where the strap is fitted, and record which limit table was used. The trend is what the substantiation uses and a reading whose limit table is unknown cannot be trended. Report any reading above the limit to the operator engineering department before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft, with the limit table selected by embodiment condition. On aircraft with the bonding strap installation, measure the strap path and the fastener path separately and read both against the post-modification table.

safety_precautions: Do not work alone inside the fin box.
Remove power and disconnect any ground cart bonding lead before measuring.
Do not abrade through the surface protection at a measurement point.
